_meta.what: Question-level label decisions for the 500 factual questions, applied by src/probe/regrade.py.
_meta.how: AI-assisted review (Claude) of results/probe_corrected/label_review.csv from round 1: question, gold answer, and the most common wrong (up to 4) and right (up to 2) sampled answers. Not checked by a second person.
_meta.blinding: Committed before any probe was rerun on corrected labels. The review sheet has no probe output. The reviewer already knew the headline results of the original run, so this is only partly blind.
_meta.rules: exclude: duplicate, undated/outdated, factually disputable, or not gradeable by string match, whether the model was graded right or wrong. accept_extra: same answer in other words. reject_if_contains: graded right only because the gold string happens to appear.

exclude.Q0283: Duplicate of F15 with an outdated gold answer (Ban Ki-moon)
